nota: Bloque 1.1. Tema de decide 30-oct: 'binance hack' (score 0.90, ganador). Cifras: TRM Labs 29-oct (USD 6.36B, preparación 36 h, 233.46M XRP entre 20:05 y 20:09 UTC, 18,270 BTC, TraderTraitor), Cointelegraph recap 30-oct (~$6.3B, mayor robo registrado, ~$3B congelados, hot wallets, reembolso total, retiros por etapas desde el domingo 1-nov).

frases.texto: Six point three billion dollars, gone in one night.
This week, hackers drained Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange.
It's the largest crypto theft on record.
And they didn't rush.
Investigators say they prepared for thirty-six hours and rehearsed first.
Then, in four minutes, two hundred thirty-three million XRP left.
Here's the part nobody tells you.
They didn't crack a vault. They drained hot wallets, kept online for withdrawals.
About three billion is frozen, and Binance says it will cover users.
Until withdrawals reopen, your balance there is an IOU.
So where would you keep six point three billion: an exchange, or your own wallet?
Four minutes. That's all it took to empty five Binance wallets.
Thursday, eight oh five p.m. UTC: two hundred thirty-three million XRP leave.
Fifteen minutes later, eighteen thousand bitcoin follow.
By midnight, about six point three billion dollars is gone.
The largest crypto theft on record.
But here's what nobody tells you.
The attackers had prepared for thirty-six hours, and rehearsed on test wallets.
They hit hot wallets, the ones kept online to pay withdrawals.
About three billion is frozen. Binance says users will be covered.
Four minutes: would you still leave your coins on an exchange, yes or no?

ganchos.texto: Six point three billion dollars vanished from Binance in one night.
Investigators blame North Korea for the biggest crypto theft in history.
Two hundred thirty-three million XRP left Binance in four minutes.

misterio.nota: Golpe en 1 s ($6.3B en una noche), bucle '¿cómo?' con 'they didn't rush', giro de las hot wallets y cierre personal (IOU) que vuelve a la cifra.

cuenta.nota: Ritmo de reloj bueno, pero 8:05 p.m. UTC y 18,270 BTC saturan de cifras los primeros 8 s; CTA sí/no menos rico.

misterio+g1.nota: Igual de directo que el original y nombra a Binance en el segundo 1; 'vanished' suena a misterio.

misterio+g2.nota: Atribución a Corea del Norte en el gancho: sin cifra y rompe el bucle.

misterio+g3.nota: Repite la frase 'xrp' y regala la cuenta atrás.
